results.title: Weight loss drugs may help with mental health
results.description: Glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA), commonly known as drugs for diabetes and weight loss, may have additional mental health benefits, especially for people with bipolar disorder, new Griffith University research has found. The researchers analysed data from nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder who were prescribed GLP-1 medications over a 15-year period to see if the medications had any impact.

results.title: Fast-moving wildfire amid shifting winds threatens Reno, Nevada, forcing thousands to evacuate
results.description: Officials say a fast-growing wildfire in Reno, Nevada, was human-caused. The Hawk Fire grew to 13,000 acres Sunday and is uncontained. Some 42,000 residents have been ordered evacuated and another 45,000 encouraged to leave so that firefighters can reach hot spots more easily.
